dataset.name: Xuzhou gastric-cancer cohort (GSE236522)
dataset.description: Independent gastric-cancer cohort with tumor bulk RNA sequencing and individual source-provided overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The GEO series contains one bulk RNA-seq profile from a biopsy or surgical tumor specimen for each of 33 patients with gastric cancer. TRACE Explorer retains all 33 endpoint-complete profiles as a separate external cohort and does not pool them with TCGA-STAD or the CPTAC gastric-cancer cohort.
dataset.publication_citation: Su et al. NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus 2024

metadata.source_program: Xuzhou Medical University gastric-cancer prognostic-model cohort
metadata.library_method: Bulk total-RNA libraries prepared with the SMARTer mRNA-Seq Library Prep Kit and processed with CLC Genomics Workbench 11.0.1
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-provided overall-survival duration and death status
metadata.endpoint_caveat: GEO reports individual OS duration in days and death status but does not define the exact time origin. Follow-up is heterogeneous and only seven deaths are observed, so estimates from this small cohort require correspondingly cautious interpretation.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Every GEO title maps one-to-one to one patient and one column in the pinned FPKM matrix; no sample selection or pooling is required.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: The pinned GEO family SOFT contains OS duration, death status, TNM stage, age and gender for all 33 retained samples.
metadata.overlap_note: The GEO record describes 33 newly sequenced gastric-cancer tissues and does not report reuse of TCGA, CPTAC or another cohort registered in TRACE Explorer.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO files in place. Direct redistribution of the source matrix is disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Gastric-cancer tumor obtained by biopsy or surgical resection

expression.label: GEO FPKM transformed to log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: HUGO gene-symbol catalog returned by the cBioPortal gene API and frozen in the release
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All rows belonging to any repeated case-normalized source symbol are excluded rather than averaged without a source-defined aggregation rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer selects the 33 endpoint-complete columns and applies log2(FPKM + 1) once to non-negative GEO-supplied FPKM values. Symbols absent from the frozen HUGO mapping and all repeated symbols are excluded.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause as encoded in the GEO death field
